title: On Printing three hundred copies in a week
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：print　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 print 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the grower ① printed three hundred copies in a week without complaint, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② prints three hundred copies in a week with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ print three hundred copies in a week at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ printed three hundred copies in a week before — a line in the ledger for August 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Printing three hundred copies in a week without complaint, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ print the letter in the county paper with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Print the letter in the county paper at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ prints the letter in the county paper without complaint every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ printed three hundred copies in a week again when nobody else would.

⑩ To print three hundred copies in a week, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody prints three hundred copies in a week with great care again and somebody must print three hundred copies in a week without complaint all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 印刷（一般现在 prints three hundred copies in a week：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

print 意为“刊出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去刊出把那封信刊在县报上”，should ever 之后用原形 print the letter in the county paper。

print 意为“印刷”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例刊出把那封信刊在县报上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 prints。
print 意为“印刷”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地印刷一周之内印了三百份，用一般过去式 printed 叙述。
print 意为“印刷”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要印刷一周之内印了三百份，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 print 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the grower printed three hundred copies in a week without complaint, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower prints three hundred copies in a week with great care whenever the greenhouse asks.
Printing three hundred copies in a week without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever print the letter in the county paper with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse prints the letter in the county paper without complaint every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother printed three hundred copies in a week again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
